quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January - June 2026) consolidated results: net sales JPY 179,853 million (+20.8% year on year), operating income JPY 30,488 million (+39.3%), ordinary income JPY 31,419 million (+39.5%), interim net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 21,806 million (+37.5%). Management states the growth came mainly from higher sales in Advanced Materials & Semiconductor.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 FY2026 net sales JPY 179,853 million (+20.8%); operating income JPY 30,488 million (+39.3%)

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Materials & Semiconductor field, H1 FY2026: net sales JPY 99,956 million (+31.9%) and operating income JPY 30,176 million (+33.9%). Management states demand related to advanced semiconductors for AI and data centers drove higher sales to semiconductor equipment manufacturers, mainly in Asia.
quarterly_data.figure: segment sales JPY 99,956 million (+31.9%); operating income JPY 30,176 million (+33.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other fields, H1 FY2026: Energy & Environment net sales JPY 58,383 million (+7.5%), operating income JPY 1,079 million (+111.5%); management states European sales fell as growth in the hydrogen-related market slowed, while automotive sales rose mainly in Japan and Asia on steady demand for combustion measurement for hybrid vehicle development. Bio & Healthcare net sales JPY 21,513 million (+14.1%) on higher hematology analyzer sales mainly in Europe and the weaker yen; operating loss JPY 767 million (prior-year period loss JPY 1,147 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Energy & Environment JPY 58,383 million; Bio & Healthcare JPY 21,513 million

quarterly_data.signal: HORIBA STEC's Kyoto Fukuchiyama Plant, listed in the FY2025 annual securities report's new-facility plan, has been completed and started operation.
Group R&D spending in H1 FY2026 was JPY 13,441 million; the company states there was no material change in its R&D activities.
